newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares erase early gains, end lower.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares erase early gains, end lower.

text.p: Brazil stocks ended 1.57 percent lower after posting modest gains earlier, hurt once again by bellwether Telebras amid continued worries over the country's trade deficit, brokers said.
Analysts said local reports that Brazil's $750 million global bond issue had a lukewarm reception among U.S. investors also weighed on the equity market.
The Sao Paulo bourse's Bovespa index .BVSP of the 49 most traded stocks closed at 64,011 points.
Light investor interest in Brazilian stocks also reduced market volume, which shrank to $279 million today, helped by technical problems in the bourse's electronic trading system, traders said.
Telebras preferred fell 2.38 percent to end at 73.80 reais, while the firm's common stock dived 1.44 percent to 61.50 reais.
Analysts said local shares could weaken on Tuesday unless "a very positive market-moving news comes out."
